title: Hotel food GST:
items: Look at last financial year's room rates.
Was any room sold above ₹7,500 for one night (per unit, per day)?
Yes: restaurant bills this year are 18% GST.
And you can claim input credit on the GST you pay on purchases.
No: restaurant bills stay at 5% GST.
But no input credit on purchases at 5%.
Do the maths on one bill.
₹2,000 dinner: 5% = ₹100 GST. 18% = ₹360 GST. A ₹260 gap per bill.
The test uses the previous financial year, so a new year can change your rate.
Confirm with your CA before you change your billing.
Rules and notifications can change. This sheet is a starting point, not tax advice.
